mapper.select: SELECT parser_version, updated_at AS parsed_at, character_count, warnings::text AS warnings_json, block_count FROM document_parse_result WHERE document_id = #{id} AND document_version = #{version}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO document_parsed_block(document_id, document_version, block_index, text, page, chapter, section, metadata) VALUES
(#{id}, #{version}, #{block.blockIndex}, #{block.text}, #{block.page,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{block.chapter,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{block.section,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{block.metadataJson} AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO document_parse_result(document_id, document_version, source_format, parser_version, block_count, character_count, warnings) VALUES (#{result.documentId}, #{result.documentVersion}, #{result.format}, #{result.parserVersion}, #{result.blockCount}, #{result.characterCount}, CAST(#{result.warningsJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (document_id, document_version) DO UPDATE SET source_format = excluded.source_format, parser_version = excluded.parser_version, block_count = excluded.block_count, character_count = excluded.character_count, warnings = excluded.warnings
